_nguon: Stage 4.2 English overlay — Planets × 12 Zodiac Signs. Editorial draft in the modern Western astrological tradition; no verbatim source text.

bach_duong.tom_tat: Aries expresses direct initiative, candid candor, and quick readiness to begin.

kim_nguu.tom_tat: Taurus expresses steady accumulation, tangible craft, and unhurried reliability.

song_tu.tom_tat: Gemini expresses curious inquiry, agile dialogue, and multi-threaded learning.

cu_giai.tom_tat: Cancer expresses protective care, emotional memory, and devotion to safe belonging.

su_tu.tom_tat: Leo expresses warm self-direction, generous presence, and wholehearted expression.

xu_nu.tom_tat: Virgo expresses discerning refinement, practical service, and clean organization.

thien_binh.tom_tat: Libra expresses fair-minded mediation, relational poise, and balanced proportion.

bo_cap.tom_tat: Scorpio expresses focused intensity, root-cause honesty, and deep loyalty.

nhan_ma.tom_tat: Sagittarius expresses broad horizon-seeking, candid synthesis, and love of exploration.

ma_ket.tom_tat: Capricorn expresses long-horizon discipline, structural accountability, and earned mastery.

bao_binh.tom_tat: Aquarius expresses independent systems thinking, principled reform, and civic perspective.

song_ngu.tom_tat: Pisces expresses receptive empathy, imaginative synthesis, and quiet compassion.

mat_troi.vai_tro: core conscious identity and vital direction

bach_duong.diem_sang: You feel most alive when you start something new and make your own call; you bounce back fast and dare to go first.
bach_duong.nen_de_y: You can rush, then drop things once the thrill fades; others may feel you push past them.
bach_duong.viec_ung_dung: Before diving into something new, write three concrete steps and name one person who will see it through with you.

kim_nguu.diem_sang: You feel most confident building things that last: savings, solid skills, a steady routine; you keep your word and stay patient.
kim_nguu.nen_de_y: You can be stubborn and resist change even when the old way no longer fits; you may hold on to things and habits.
kim_nguu.viec_ung_dung: Each month, make one deliberate small change (a new method, a different spend) so steady does not turn rigid.

song_tu.diem_sang: You light up when you learn, ask, talk and connect people; your mind is quick and adaptable.
song_tu.nen_de_y: You can take on too much at once and spread thin, talking more than doing; others may find you inconsistent.
song_tu.viec_ung_dung: Pick one subject to study in depth for three months and note what you got done each week.

cu_giai.diem_sang: You are strongest when you care for the people close to you and build a safe place; you sense others' feelings and remember kindness.
cu_giai.nen_de_y: You can take things personally and withdraw when hurt; sometimes you care for others and forget to state your own needs.
cu_giai.viec_ung_dung: When upset, say one plain sentence starting with 'I need…' instead of waiting for others to guess.

su_tu.diem_sang: You shine when you create, lead and are recognised; generous, warm and inspiring.
su_tu.nen_de_y: You can feel slighted when overlooked and want the spotlight; feedback may be hard to take.
su_tu.viec_ung_dung: Find one thing you are proud of doing without anyone's praise, and leave room for others to shine too.

xu_nu.diem_sang: You are at your best organising, improving and being genuinely useful; careful, practical and dedicated.
xu_nu.nen_de_y: You can be hard on yourself and others, fret over small details and rarely feel satisfied.
xu_nu.viec_ung_dung: Set a 'good enough' bar before each task and stop when you reach it; note one thing you did well each day.

thien_binh.diem_sang: You are strong at balancing sides, building harmony and beauty; fair, courteous and good at teamwork.
thien_binh.nen_de_y: You can hesitate and delay decisions to avoid upsetting anyone; sometimes you accommodate too much.
thien_binh.viec_ung_dung: Give small decisions a short deadline; practise saying 'no' gently.

bo_cap.diem_sang: You are strong when you see something through and look beneath the surface; determined, deep and loyal.
bo_cap.nen_de_y: You can hold things inside, grow suspicious and find it hard to let go; you may want control.
bo_cap.viec_ung_dung: Choose one trusted person to tell what you have been holding in; let go of one thing that does not need your control.

nhan_ma.diem_sang: You feel most alive travelling, learning big ideas and seeking meaning; optimistic, frank and generous.
nhan_ma.nen_de_y: You can over-promise and dodge details or long commitments; your bluntness may hurt.
nhan_ma.viec_ung_dung: Turn one big wish into a plan with real dates; before speaking bluntly, think how the listener will take it.

ma_ket.diem_sang: You are strong at setting long-term goals and climbing step by step; disciplined, responsible and reliable.
ma_ket.nen_de_y: You can overwork, be strict with yourself and hide your feelings; you may measure your worth by results.
ma_ket.viec_ung_dung: Schedule fixed rest time alongside work; each week do one thing purely for fun.

bao_binh.diem_sang: You are strong at thinking differently, improving how things work and serving the common good; independent, open to the new, loyal to friends.
bao_binh.nen_de_y: You can seem distant, hold tightly to your views and shy away from emotional closeness.
bao_binh.viec_ung_dung: Test a new idea right away with a real group; ask loved ones how they feel, not only what they think.

song_ngu.diem_sang: You are strong in imagination and compassion; intuitive, artistic and kind-hearted.
song_ngu.nen_de_y: You can drift, avoid hard facts and get swept along by others; boundaries are hard to set.
song_ngu.viec_ung_dung: Keep one regular activity with clear hours; write down your limits before agreeing to help someone.

mat_trang.vai_tro: instinctive emotional rhythm, habit patterns, and inner safety

bach_duong.diem_sang: You need freedom and quick responses; feelings flare up and pass fast, and you say what you see.
bach_duong.nen_de_y: Waiting irritates you, and when annoyed you may speak before thinking.
bach_duong.viec_ung_dung: When annoyed, move for ten minutes (a walk, the stairs) before you reply.

kim_nguu.diem_sang: You feel settled with familiar routines, good food and a comfortable home; your moods are steady.
kim_nguu.nen_de_y: Sudden change unsettles you for a long time; you may seek comfort in food or shopping.
kim_nguu.viec_ung_dung: Keep a small evening ritual (tea, music, tidying your sleep corner) to calm down instead of shopping.

song_tu.diem_sang: You calm down by talking, reading and understanding what is going on; your feelings are flexible.
song_tu.nen_de_y: You may analyse feelings instead of feeling them; your mind finds it hard to rest.
song_tu.viec_ung_dung: Write three lines each night: what happened, how you felt, what you need.

cu_giai.diem_sang: You need a sense of family, to be sheltered and to shelter others; warm-hearted with a long memory.
cu_giai.nen_de_y: Your mood rises and falls with the atmosphere at home; careless words hurt.
cu_giai.viec_ung_dung: Make one corner of home truly comfortable; when someone hurts you, ask what they meant instead of guessing.

su_tu.diem_sang: You need love shown clearly and to feel valued; when happy you are warm and big-hearted.
su_tu.nen_de_y: You may feel hurt when ignored and need praise to feel okay.
su_tu.viec_ung_dung: Acknowledge yourself for one thing each day; tell loved ones what kind of attention you hope for.

xu_nu.diem_sang: You feel settled when things are in order and you can be useful; you show love through practical help.
xu_nu.nen_de_y: You can worry, blame yourself and feel tense when things are messy.
xu_nu.viec_ung_dung: When worried, list what is in your hands and do the smallest item right away.

thien_binh.diem_sang: You need harmony and company; you are most at ease when relationships are smooth.
thien_binh.nen_de_y: You may swallow irritation to keep the peace, then feel drained without saying why.
thien_binh.viec_ung_dung: Practise stating what bothers you in one gentle sentence the same day, instead of letting it pile up.

bo_cap.diem_sang: Your feelings run deep and strong; you need trust and sincere closeness.
bo_cap.nen_de_y: You may feel jealous, hold on to the past and find it hard to open up before you fully trust.
bo_cap.viec_ung_dung: Write down what is weighing on you and sleep on it before acting; share it bit by bit with someone you trust.

nhan_ma.diem_sang: You need space and new experiences to feel happy; optimistic and quick to bounce back.
nhan_ma.nen_de_y: You may dodge heavy feelings by going out or keeping busy; sitting with sadness is hard.
nhan_ma.viec_ung_dung: When something sad happens, set aside one session just to think it through before looking for something new.

ma_ket.diem_sang: You feel settled when things are under control and responsibilities are clear; steady and rarely complaining.
ma_ket.nen_de_y: You may hide feelings, carry everything alone and avoid asking for help.
ma_ket.viec_ung_dung: Each week, ask someone for one small favour, and share one real feeling with a loved one.

bao_binh.diem_sang: You need freedom and to be yourself; you value friends and stay calm in a storm.
bao_binh.nen_de_y: You may detach from feelings, and loved ones may find you cool or distant.
bao_binh.viec_ung_dung: See loved ones in person more often; when they are sad, ask 'do you want me to listen or to advise?'.

song_ngu.diem_sang: You sense things finely, empathise easily and need quiet time and your own inner world.
song_ngu.nen_de_y: You may absorb other people's feelings as your own and feel drained without knowing why; you may escape.
song_ngu.viec_ung_dung: After seeing many people, give yourself quiet time; practise asking 'is this feeling mine or theirs?'.

thuy_tinh.vai_tro: information processing, reasoning style, and everyday communication

bach_duong.diem_sang: You think fast, speak plainly and decide quickly; you are good at opening a discussion and getting to the point.
bach_duong.nen_de_y: You may cut people off or conclude before hearing everything; words said in a hurry can sting.
bach_duong.viec_ung_dung: In an important conversation, wait until the other person finishes and repeat their point in one sentence before you answer.

kim_nguu.diem_sang: You think slowly but solidly, remember for a long time and say little but clearly; you learn best by doing and seeing real examples.
kim_nguu.nen_de_y: Once you hold an opinion it is hard to shift; you may skip new information because the old way still seems fine.
kim_nguu.viec_ung_dung: When choosing, write down two options with concrete numbers (time, cost) before you settle.

song_tu.diem_sang: Your mind is quick and curious about many things at once; you talk with charm and pick up languages and new skills fast.
song_tu.nen_de_y: You may juggle many topics and finish few; talking a lot can crowd out listening.
song_tu.viec_ung_dung: Keep a notebook of ideas; each week pick exactly one to carry through and park the rest.

cu_giai.diem_sang: You think with feeling and memory; you recall small details about loved ones and know what to say to someone who is sad.
cu_giai.nen_de_y: Your mood can colour how you hear others; one hurtful remark may stay with you a long time.
cu_giai.viec_ung_dung: When a remark unsettles you, ask "do you mean...?" before drawing your own conclusion.

su_tu.diem_sang: You speak persuasively, tell stories well and like presenting your ideas to a group.
su_tu.nen_de_y: You may take disagreement as a matter of pride; sometimes you speak to be recognised rather than to exchange.
su_tu.viec_ung_dung: After you present, invite one suggestion from the listeners and thank them for it in front of everyone.

xu_nu.diem_sang: Your mind is precise, good at organising information and spotting small errors others miss; you write and explain clearly.
xu_nu.nen_de_y: You may nitpick yourself and others; you can worry in circles over details that do not matter yet.
xu_nu.viec_ung_dung: When giving feedback, say one good point first, then what to fix, and stop at three items at most.

thien_binh.diem_sang: You weigh both sides, speak courteously and are good at smoothing things over and finding tactful words.
thien_binh.nen_de_y: You may hesitate when you must choose, or talk around a point so no one is upset.
thien_binh.viec_ung_dung: Give small decisions a deadline (say, one day); when time is up, pick the option you already lean toward.

bo_cap.diem_sang: You think deeply and read the motive behind words; you are good at getting to the root, keeping secrets and asking the hard question.
bo_cap.nen_de_y: You may grow suspicious and read hidden meaning where there is none; words spoken when hurt can be sharp.
bo_cap.viec_ung_dung: When in doubt, write down what you know for sure and what you only guess, then ask directly about the guess.

nhan_ma.diem_sang: You think broadly and love big ideas, philosophy and faraway places; you speak frankly, cheerfully and spread enthusiasm.
nhan_ma.nen_de_y: You may promise quickly and skip details; your honesty can lack tact.
nhan_ma.viec_ung_dung: Before promising, ask yourself how many steps it takes and how long, and state that number with the promise.

ma_ket.diem_sang: You think systematically and practically and speak briefly to the point; you plan well and think long term.
ma_ket.nen_de_y: You may be too serious and dismiss new ideas that show no quick benefit; your feedback can sound dry.
ma_ket.viec_ung_dung: Each week spend ten minutes hearing out one "unrealistic" idea from someone else without arguing back.

bao_binh.diem_sang: You think independently, like new methods and see problems from angles few others take; you reason well and like technology.
bao_binh.nen_de_y: You may hold a view just to stand apart; sometimes you argue logic and forget how the listener feels.
bao_binh.viec_ung_dung: In a debate, ask one question about how the other person feels before giving your reasons.

song_ngu.diem_sang: You think in images and intuition and have a rich imagination; you speak gently and sense what others feel.
song_ngu.nen_de_y: You may drift, forget details and be vague about agreements; you may nod along just to close the matter.
song_ngu.viec_ung_dung: Put anything important in writing (a message, a note) right after you agree on it.

kim_tinh.vai_tro: values, aesthetic taste, and how affection and rapport are shared

bach_duong.diem_sang: In love you take the lead, like fresh feelings and show them openly; your taste is bold and eye-catching.
bach_duong.nen_de_y: Your interest may flare fast and cool fast; you may shop on impulse.
bach_duong.viec_ung_dung: When you like someone or something, wait three days before deciding; if you still like it, go ahead.

kim_nguu.diem_sang: You love slowly and steadily and show it through practical care; you enjoy quality things, good food and a comfortable home.
kim_nguu.nen_de_y: You may want to hold on tightly and resist change in a relationship; comfort can take a big share of your spending.
kim_nguu.viec_ung_dung: Set a fixed monthly amount for your own pleasures and stop when it is used up.

song_tu.diem_sang: You are drawn to people you can talk with, who are fun and quick; your taste is varied and you like trying different styles.
song_tu.nen_de_y: You may change your mind about who you like; heavy emotional talks can make you uneasy.
song_tu.viec_ung_dung: Once a week, spend an evening talking with your partner with the phone put away.

cu_giai.diem_sang: You love by protecting and remember small things about the person you care for; you like keepsakes and a warm atmosphere.
cu_giai.nen_de_y: You may feel hurt when care is not returned the way you hoped; you keep old things for sentimental reasons.
cu_giai.viec_ung_dung: State one need in a concrete sentence ("I need a message when you will be late") instead of waiting to be guessed.

su_tu.diem_sang: You love warmly and generously and like being appreciated openly; your taste is stylish with a touch of flair.
su_tu.nen_de_y: You may feel hurt when overlooked; sometimes you spend to keep up appearances.
su_tu.viec_ung_dung: Each day praise your partner for one specific thing; the way you want to be treated is the way to give.

xu_nu.diem_sang: You show affection through deeds: helping, organising, remembering things for the other person; you like neatness and refinement.
xu_nu.nen_de_y: You may criticise small details and expect a lot of yourself and your partner; sweet words do not come easily.
xu_nu.viec_ung_dung: For one week, swap one piece of criticism a day for one specific thank-you and notice how the mood changes.

thien_binh.diem_sang: You value harmony, courtesy and fairness in relationships; you have a good eye and enjoy balanced beauty.
thien_binh.nen_de_y: You may go along with others to keep the peace and then feel resentful; being alone can feel uncomfortable.
thien_binh.viec_ung_dung: Once a week say "no" to something you do not want, gently but clearly.

bo_cap.diem_sang: You love deeply and loyally and need complete trust; you like beauty that is understated and has depth.
bo_cap.nen_de_y: You may get jealous and hold on to hurt; letting go after being let down is hard.
bo_cap.viec_ung_dung: When you feel insecure, name the feeling with "I feel..." instead of checking up on or testing the other person.

nhan_ma.diem_sang: You are drawn to open-minded people to travel and learn with; you love freedom and fun and your taste is easygoing.
nhan_ma.nen_de_y: You may shy away from commitment and feel boxed in when a relationship settles into routine; you may overspend on experiences.
nhan_ma.viec_ung_dung: Plan a trip or a class with your partner, but keep one evening a week just for yourself.

ma_ket.diem_sang: You love seriously and open up slowly, showing care through responsibility and shared plans; you like classic, lasting things.
ma_ket.nen_de_y: You may come across as dry and put work ahead of feelings; you may count every coin when spending.
ma_ket.viec_ung_dung: Schedule time with your partner the way you schedule work, and keep it on time.

bao_binh.diem_sang: You want friendship inside love and respect personal space; your taste is unusual and unlike the crowd.
bao_binh.nen_de_y: You may keep emotional distance so the other person feels far away; very close bonds can feel tight.
bao_binh.viec_ung_dung: Tell your partner clearly how much time alone you need, so distance is not mistaken for coldness.

song_ngu.diem_sang: You love romantically, empathise easily and will give a lot for the one you love; you are moved by art and music.
song_ngu.nen_de_y: You may idealise the other person and give beyond your means; money can slip away out of politeness.
song_ngu.viec_ung_dung: Before helping someone with a large sum or a big effort, sleep on it and ask a clear-headed friend.

hoa_tinh.vai_tro: action drive, boundary assertion, and stamina under pressure

bach_duong.diem_sang: You act fast, take on hard tasks and come alive with a challenge; you react at once under pressure.
bach_duong.nen_de_y: You may flare up and cool down fast, but words said in anger linger; you may drop things once the thrill fades.
bach_duong.viec_ung_dung: Break long tasks into short stages with deadlines and give yourself a small reward after each one.

kim_nguu.diem_sang: You have staying power: slow to start but you finish what you begin; you excel at work that needs persistence and craft.
kim_nguu.nen_de_y: Changing course once you have started is hard; you anger slowly but stay angry long.
kim_nguu.viec_ung_dung: When pushed to change plans, ask for a short pause to rearrange before you answer.

song_tu.diem_sang: You run several tasks at once and react quickly with words; you suit varied work with lots of contact.
song_tu.nen_de_y: Your energy scatters easily; when annoyed you argue with logic, which can turn into long disputes.
song_tu.viec_ung_dung: Each day pick three main tasks and finish them before opening anything new.

cu_giai.diem_sang: You act most strongly when protecting your family and the place you belong; you are persistent and good at the indirect route.
cu_giai.nen_de_y: You may sulk instead of speaking plainly; your mood strongly affects your energy for work.
cu_giai.viec_ung_dung: When upset, say one concrete sentence about what you need that day instead of letting it pile up.

su_tu.diem_sang: You work with flair, like to lead and give everything when handed the main role.
su_tu.nen_de_y: You may take offence when criticised in front of others; sometimes winning matters more to you than the result.
su_tu.viec_ung_dung: This month take on one task that helps someone else do their part well, so your drive to lead has somewhere to go.

xu_nu.diem_sang: You work precisely and methodically, improving bit by bit; you excel at tasks that need skill and checking.
xu_nu.nen_de_y: You may hoard work for fear others will not do it well and carry quiet stress; make time to rest.
xu_nu.viec_ung_dung: Hand one small task to someone else and accept a "good enough" result the first time.

thien_binh.diem_sang: You act through cooperation, negotiate well and speak up for fairness.
thien_binh.nen_de_y: You may hesitate and avoid confrontation, then build up resentment; sometimes you let others decide for you.
thien_binh.viec_ung_dung: When you disagree, set a specific time within three days to talk it through; do not let it run past a week.

bo_cap.diem_sang: You have great focus and determination and rarely give up; you handle difficult work and work that needs discretion.
bo_cap.nen_de_y: You may hold anger inside for a long time and it comes out strongly; letting go is hard once you have decided to see it through.
bo_cap.viec_ung_dung: Find a regular outlet for energy (running, sport, hands-on work) so frustration does not build up.

nhan_ma.diem_sang: You chase what you believe in with enthusiasm and love adventure and learning; you work best with a big purpose.
nhan_ma.nen_de_y: You may get heated when blocked and lose patience with small chores; you often overdo it and tire.
nhan_ma.viec_ung_dung: Write your big purpose down, then pull out one small task you can do today.

ma_ket.diem_sang: You are disciplined, work steadily to plan, handle pressure and climb step by step.
ma_ket.nen_de_y: You may overwork out of duty and hold anger until it turns cold; make time to rest.
ma_ket.viec_ung_dung: Set aside one session a week to move your body just to feel well, with no performance target.

bao_binh.diem_sang: You act on ideals and in your own way; you are good at reinventing processes and teamwork toward a shared goal.
bao_binh.nen_de_y: You may resist rules simply because you dislike being told; when annoyed you go cold and withdraw.
bao_binh.viec_ung_dung: Before objecting to a rule, write down one concrete alternative.

song_ngu.diem_sang: You work from inspiration and adapt easily, suiting creative work or helping people; soft yet persistent in your own way.
song_ngu.nen_de_y: You may avoid conflict and let annoyance simmer; your energy rises and falls with your mood.
song_ngu.viec_ung_dung: Write the day's tasks on paper and work through them in order, even when you do not feel like it yet.

moc_tinh.vai_tro: growth horizon, guiding philosophy, and constructive generosity

bach_duong.diem_sang: People born while Jupiter was in Aries (a cohort of about one year) tend to do well when they open their own path; they trust their strength and get excited by new starts.
bach_duong.nen_de_y: You may take on too much out of confidence in your strength.
bach_duong.viec_ung_dung: Each year pick one new project to lead yourself and see it through to a result.

kim_nguu.diem_sang: People born while Jupiter was in Taurus (a cohort of about one year) grow through steady building: savings, skill and a settled routine; they are generous with family.
kim_nguu.nen_de_y: You may spend freely on comfort.
kim_nguu.viec_ung_dung: Keep a regular monthly saving, however small.

song_tu.diem_sang: People born while Jupiter was in Gemini (a cohort of about one year) grow through learning, reading and conversation; they know many people and often find openings through introductions.
song_tu.nen_de_y: You may know a little about a lot without going deep.
song_tu.viec_ung_dung: Each year choose one field to study properly, besides what you read for fun.

cu_giai.diem_sang: People born while Jupiter was in Cancer (a cohort of about one year) feel well off when the family is at peace; they like helping and looking after relatives.
cu_giai.nen_de_y: You may over-protect the people close to you.
cu_giai.viec_ung_dung: Help relatives in ways that let them do it themselves rather than doing it for them.

su_tu.diem_sang: People born while Jupiter was in Leo (a cohort of about one year) are big-hearted, like doing things on a large scale and have a flair for creative and public work.
su_tu.nen_de_y: You may show off or promise big.
su_tu.viec_ung_dung: Attach a concrete date to every big promise.

xu_nu.diem_sang: People born while Jupiter was in Virgo (a cohort of about one year) grow by doing each detail well; good fortune comes through skill and being useful.
xu_nu.nen_de_y: You may get lost in small things and lose the big picture.
xu_nu.viec_ung_dung: Once a quarter, look at where your small tasks are leading.

thien_binh.diem_sang: People born while Jupiter was in Libra (a cohort of about one year) do well through partnership, good relationships and fair dealing; they make friends easily.
thien_binh.nen_de_y: You may say yes too often to avoid upsetting anyone.
thien_binh.viec_ung_dung: Choose your collaborators carefully and agree on clear terms from the start.

bo_cap.diem_sang: People born while Jupiter was in Scorpio (a cohort of about one year) grow stronger by going deep into one thing; they are good at getting to the root and handling shared resources.
bo_cap.nen_de_y: You may pour everything into a single direction.
bo_cap.viec_ung_dung: When you commit to something big, always keep a backup plan.

nhan_ma.diem_sang: People born while Jupiter was in Sagittarius (a cohort of about one year) are optimistic, love travel and higher learning and have strong faith in what they pursue.
nhan_ma.nen_de_y: You may be so optimistic that you overlook risk.
nhan_ma.viec_ung_dung: Before a big step, write down three things that may not go as hoped and how you would handle each.

ma_ket.diem_sang: People born while Jupiter was in Capricorn (a cohort of about one year) advance slowly but surely through discipline and responsibility; they earn trust once results show.
ma_ket.nen_de_y: You may be strict with your own enjoyment.
ma_ket.viec_ung_dung: Allow yourself a small pleasure after each finished stage of work.

bao_binh.diem_sang: People born while Jupiter was in Aquarius (a cohort of about one year) grow through new ideas, friends and community; they enjoy work for the common good.
bao_binh.nen_de_y: You may chase distant ideals and forget what is close by.
bao_binh.viec_ung_dung: Turn one community idea into something you can do within a month.

song_ngu.diem_sang: People born while Jupiter was in Pisces (a cohort of about one year) are compassionate and understanding, with a gift for art and helping others.
song_ngu.nen_de_y: You may feel you have helped enough because your intentions are good, without checking whether it truly helps.
song_ngu.viec_ung_dung: Set clear limits on the time and money you give to others.

tho_tinh.vai_tro: structural discipline, realistic limits, and long-term craft

bach_duong.diem_sang: People born while Saturn was in Aries (a cohort of about two and a half years) learn patience and self-control; they mature by seeing through what they start.
bach_duong.nen_de_y: When young you may rush, or the opposite, hold back from stepping forward.
bach_duong.viec_ung_dung: Practise finishing one task fully before starting another.

kim_nguu.diem_sang: People born while Saturn was in Taurus (a cohort of about two and a half years) learn about money and self-worth; they build a solid base by persisting step by step.
kim_nguu.nen_de_y: You may worry about not having enough even when you do.
kim_nguu.viec_ung_dung: Keep a simple income and spending sheet and review it each month.

song_tu.diem_sang: People born while Saturn was in Gemini (a cohort of about two and a half years) learn to think and speak with focus; they improve through serious study.
song_tu.nen_de_y: You may dread speaking in public or fear you do not understand enough.
song_tu.viec_ung_dung: Prepare three main points before each time you speak.

song_ngu.viec_ung_dung: Help people with empathy, but keep time for yourself.
